briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-3 escalate AGI race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple new models this month while regulatory pressure mounts. Compute buildout continues at unprecedented scale across US and Middle East. Prompt injection attacks persist as the dominant production risk.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4 with improved reasoning; xAI released Grok-3; DeepSeek-V4 matched GPT-4o performance at lower cost. Meta's Llama 4.1 open weights triggered widespread fine-tuning. Google DeepMind previewed Gemini 3 with native multimodal agents.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Oracle announced joint 200k H100 cluster in Texas; UAE sovereign fund committed $4B to new Stargate-class site. NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reached 1.2M units shipped this quarter.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight frontier models overtake closed labs in capability by end of 2027?
